item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed four recommendations arising from three reports on misconduct risks in Department of Transport licensing and vehicle examinations.
item.support: a follow up review of Transport's continued implementation of three of the earlier recommendations.

item.text: The recommendations concerned driving assessment bookings, photographs of vehicle examinations, invoice audits and recognition of overseas driving licences.
item.support: Department of Transport implement a rigorous audit program of invoices against TRELIS.

item.text: The Commission concluded that booking controls and audits had improved, accepted the proposed regulatory changes and closed all recommendations.
item.support: Transport has considered and, where appropriate, taken steps to implement the Commission's recommendations.

item.text: The Commission also closed the photographic evidence recommendation after the department considered it and declined implementation because of cost.
item.support: Transport has considered this recommendation and determined that it is not feasible for implementation.

item.quote: The Commission considers all recommendations closed.
The regulatory reform proposed by Transport is appropriate and logical.
